title: Can't Hurt Me
author: David Goggins
blurb: Callousing the mind when comfort wants to quit.
description: Goggins’ story is extreme on purpose: Navy SEAL, ultramarathons, and the 40% rule — the claim that when your mind says you’re done, you’re usually only partway there. It’s not a gentle self-help book. It’s a hard push for anyone who has been negotiating with their own excuses and needs a louder voice in the room.
